# A formation's couplings as its blanket, and when a blanket constrains

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-formations-couplings-as-its-blanket` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](a-formations-couplings-as-its-blanket.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A formation's couplings make any model they feed a blanketed agent; degenerate readings refute no determined family, sparse ones fixed apart can fail on one run; there, step external, its level is internal to a law determined part by part exactly where level, what couples in and act fix the next.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The coupling law: where a formation's couplings give the values of what couples into it, any model and policy, and any environment, which may read the act, make a blanketed law whose sensory part's next state is the value of what couples in at the step, the step on the world's side; its sensory course is the formation's own course through its couplings under its own level history (sensory_course and four more). (`Becoming.BlanketCouplings.couplingLaw`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.startAt`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.clock`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.ownLevels`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.sensory_course`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Two of its courses from one agent are alike on the blanket before n + 2 exactly where their own level histories are alike through the couplings up to n, the environment reading the act or not; then their internal courses agree up to n + 2. In the closed loop both sides are read off one course (blanket_iff_through, internal_through_couplings). (`Becoming.BlanketCouplings.blanket_iff_through`, `Becoming.BlanketCouplings.internal_through_couplings`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. In the open loop, the act moving no level, every reading of the internal course up to n + 2 is a selection through the formation's couplings up to n, whatever the model and the policy (internal_selectsThrough and five more). <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Any web, formation and couplings by level, supplied, whose values the web's admission and the levels give (ValuesThrough); any model, policy, environment state, levels and environment step.
- For the readings: any family of courses with moves, and any map from configurations to four parts, read by one map at every step of a law the same at every step.
- Modelling choices: discrete synchronous steps; determined laws; the four parts of types in Type; the blanket as sparse coupling, not conditional independence; which map a thing's partition is read by is not derived.
- For a formation's level: one run of a World (World.of R L W), balanced where the exchange form is used, the step the external part; a value across steps (ValuesAcross), the step entering only through admission at each step; the act its rows on listed relata at the steps a presence course marks, which may decide where it takes part (DecidesPresence); amounts in Nat.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That having the coupling law constrains a formation's course: it is a construction, the step on the world's side and the environment arbitrary.
- A formation's records other than its level as the internal part: for these the agent is a model fed by what couples in.
- The World's own exchange as an environment: the join's World case is the open loop, the closed loop a model beside it; along one run the level's reading carries the exchange in the level, the rest entering only through the step.
- A formation's level as the internal part across a family of runs, or with the step off the world's side, where the world's half is a condition; for self-bearing formations, whose own level couples in, nothing beyond one run with the step.
- A blanketed law for every family consistent part by part, or functions for a consistent course: a next state at every reading no course shows is needed.
- That the principle is wrong: no sentence of its literature is forbidden here.
- **Counterexample:** The run whose internal part's next state is whether the external part, cycling through three values, is at its first is the course of no blanketed law on its four parts (ReadsExternal.not_blanketed). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/BlanketCouplings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** With the step but not which course outside, two courses alike at steps 0 and 1 and parting at 2 have no law determined part by part (clock_only_fails). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/BlanketCouplings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Under the identity reading, injective, a run whose law is determined is not consistent part by part (injective_converse_fails). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/BlanketCouplings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Two courses from one value parting at their first step: the family is not consistent, its clocked reading consistent part by part (clocked_witness). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/BlanketCouplings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A drain in three phases: nothing couples into the formation and the run balances, yet at steps 2 and 3 its level, value and act agree and its next levels differ, so for every value across steps no law determined part by part admits the run read with its level internal (PhasedDrain.not_admitted). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/BlanketCouplings.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The principle defines a thing by its Markov blanket (Friston 2013, 2019; Kirchhoff and others 2018). That a blanket depends on how a partition is read is argued in words: Pearl's blankets, fixed within a model, against Friston's, read as a thing's boundary (Bruineberg, Dołęga, Dewhurst and Baltieri 2022). Wider: a formalism for any domain explains life and mind less than claimed (Raja and others 2021); statistical and dynamical blankets differ (Biehl, Pollock and Kanai 2021); its proponents concede the existence claim is not strictly falsifiable (Ramstead and others 2023). The coupling form is the deterministic time-unrolled blanket (Virgo, Rosas and Biehl 2022), which compares courses from one start, so a single run constrains nothing under it; a single run can refute a law the same at every step on the agent's side, which that blanket does not require, read by a partition fixed apart (ReadsExternal, of Hexagram.runsOrder_reads' kind; for a formation's level, PhasedDrain). The level's condition is the elementary one for one trajectory of a time-invariant deterministic state machine, here on the World's exchange. AI reading: which blanket a thing has is how its parts are read.
